correctness.rationale: At exploration starts the contracting affine recursion gives exploration variance Q=2D/[r(1−a²)]. Cycle occupancy is p_E=1/(1+rm), refractory variance a²Q; thus C(0)/Q=(1+a²rm)/(1+rm) recovers m when 0<a<1. Brownian innovations after time 0 have zero conditional covariance with X_0, so C(t) is Q/(1+rm) times the future multiplicative reset-count PGF from exploration plus a²rm times the equilibrium refractory-residual PGF. Alternating-renewal equations yield F̂_E=[s+ar(1−w)]/[s(s+r−ar w)], residual transform (1−w)/(ms). Algebraically solving the resulting Möbius map gives the stated inversion except at s=ar, where the denominator cancels and w is recovered by continuity; the same cancellation gives universal Ĉ(ar) and sign-crossing identity. Independently checked symbolic inversion and exact-rational exponential-duration cases; a=0 is correctly excluded since complete resetting loses clock law information.

value.rationale: Exact identifiability of an arbitrary distribution W from a single stationary *second-order time statistic* is a substantive semi-Markov inverse phenomenon: one-time law forgets all but m, while all lag-covariances recover W. The universal blind frequency provides a sharp model signature and shows an isolated observation cannot identify W. All positive a,r,D and all finite-mean measures (including atoms) are covered; an exact natural inverse result with possible use in renewal-process inference.
